title: Peptide‐Catalyzed Desymmetrization of an Achiral Ferrocenyl Compound To Induce Planar Chirality
abstract: AbstractSelective monohydrogenation of an achiral ferrocenebis(enal) was achieved with a resin‐supported peptide catalyst to afford an enantioenriched planar‐chiral product. It was also demonstrated that the reaction was followed by a kinetic resolution through cyclization of the product.
